mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), rising employment (PAYEMS growth > 0.1% monthly) signals a labor market recovery that boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) series indicates strong residential construction activity, reflecting robust consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, indicating economic slowdown and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL above 2.5% signal aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 100.0), rising industrial production (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly) signals a recovery in manufacturing output, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 and INDPRO growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
